blocks.content: Coastal geomorphology deals with landforms created by sea waves and marine processes. Waves, tides, and ocean currents constantly reshape coastlines through erosion, transportation, and deposition. Coastal regions are dynamic zones where land meets the ocean.
Coastal regions are dynamic zones where land meets the ocean.

items: Be prepared to identify the three core processes of coastal transformation: erosion, transportation, and deposition.
Note the three main agents responsible for reshaping coastlines: sea waves, tides, and ocean currents.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Coastal geomorphology studies landforms created by sea waves and marine processes.
Waves, tides, and ocean currents continuously alter and reshape coastal landforms.
The three main active processes in coastal zones are erosion, transportation, and deposition.
Coastal regions are highly dynamic zones where land and ocean meet.
